description: This file defines the VideoOverlay class for the Leaflet mapping library, extending ImageOverlay to display video content over map bounds. It includes options for autoplay, looping, and aspect ratio preservation, and provides a factory function for instantiation.

classes.name: VideoOverlay
classes.description: A class extending ImageOverlay to load and display a video over specific map bounds, with configurable options for autoplay, looping, and aspect ratio.

methods.name: _initImage
methods.description: Initializes the video element, sets classes, event handlers, and appends source elements based on provided URL or element.
